body:
### Summary

When `XDG_DATA_HOME` is set, `install.sh` derives its install directory as the literal string `$XDG_DATA_HOME/../bin` and never resolves it. Because two later checks compare that string against a resolved path, they result in:

1. Spurious `WARN: The following commands are shadowed by other commands in your PATH: uv uvx` on every install, when nothing is shadowed.
2. The `PATH`-modification step concludes the install dir isn't on `PATH` when it is, and appends source lines to six shell config files that didn't need them.

The second one is self-reinforcing: the line it adds prepends the unnormalized path to `PATH`, which guarantees the warning fires on every subsequent run, including runs with an explicit `UV_INSTALL_DIR`.

## Environment

- `uv 0.12.17 (635500036 2026-09-18 aarch64-apple-darwin)`
- macOS 27.0 (build 26A428, Darwin 27.0.0, arm64)
- `XDG_DATA_HOME=$HOME/.local/share`
- `$HOME/.local/bin` already on `PATH`, added by my own shell config
- `zsh`, with `ZDOTDIR=$HOME/.config/zsh`
- No other uv on the system (no Homebrew formula, no cargo install, one binary total)

## Reproduction

```zsh
$ export XDG_DATA_HOME="$HOME/.local/share"
$ export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
$ curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

downloading uv 0.12.17 aarch64-apple-darwin
installing to /Users/me/.local/share/../bin
  uv
  uvx
everything's installed!
WARN: The following commands are shadowed by other commands in your PATH: uv uvx
```

`which -a uv` returns exactly one path. Nothing is shadowed.

The install also appended `. "$HOME/.local/share/../bin/env"` to `~/.profile`, `~/.bashrc`, `~/.bash_profile`, `~/.bash_login`, `~/.zshrc/`. `~/.zshenv`, and created `~/.config/fish/conf.d/uv.env.fish` and `~/.config/fish/`  on a machine with no fish installed.

I would have expected no warning, and no shell config modified, since there was no `uv` binary installed on the device and `$HOME/.local/bin` is already on `PATH`.

## Cause

`install.sh:1298` sets the install dir without resolving the path:

```shell
_install_dir="$XDG_DATA_HOME/../bin"
```

`check_for_shadowed_bins (install.sh:1434)` then compares a resolved path against that raw string.

```shell
_shadow="$(command -v "$_bin_name")"        # /Users/me/.local/bin/uv
if [ -n "$_shadow" ] && [ "$_shadow" != "$_install_dir/$_bin_name" ]; then
    # /Users/me/.local/share/../bin/uv  →  never equal
```

The same string is used for the already-on-`PATH` check at `install.sh:1401`.

```shell
case :$PATH: in *:$_install_dir:*) NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 ;;
```

`PATH` contains `/Users/me/.local/bin`, not `/Users/me/.local/share/../bin`, so this never matches and `shotgun_install_dir_to_path` (`install.sh:1409`) runs against `.profile` `.bashrc` `.bash_profile` `.bash_login`

Reinstalling with `UV_INSTALL_DIR="$HOME/.local/bin"`, even after rm -rfing the binaries still warns, because the rc line added by the first run is now prepending `$HOME/.local/share/../bin` to PATH in every shell. `command -v uv` resolves through the unnormalized entry and the comparison fails again. The only fix is manually removing the line the installer added, which is non-trivial to track down.

## Suggested fix

Normalize once, at the point the default is chosen with something like

```shell
_install_dir="$(cd "$XDG_DATA_HOME/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd)/bin"
```

This would make the shadowing check and the $PATH$ check agree, and the `NO_MODIFY_PATH=1` branch at line 1401 then correctly suppresses all six rc edits on systems where the directory is already on `PATH`.

### Separately, and lower priority

creating `~/.config/fish/` on a machine with no fish binary seems worth gating on `command -v fish`, and writing to `.bashrc`, `.bash_profile`, and `.bash_login` unconditionally is more invasive in my opinion than the situation calls for. I'd personally rather be told which line to add than have it added for me. That said, the path resolution bug is the actionable part here, and fixing it means the rc files mostly stop being touched at all.

### Platform

macOS 27.0 (build 26A428, Darwin 27.0.0, arm64)

### Version

uv 0.12.17 (635500036 2026-09-18 aarch64-apple-darwin)

### Python version

Python 3.14.7
title: `install.sh` unresolved $XDG_DATA_HOME/../bin causes false "shadowed by other commands" warning and unnecessary rc-file edits
